```{r, echo = FALSE, results = 'hide'}
# Generate data
scores <- c(82, 87, 78, 89, 57, 64, 81, 98)
res <- mean(scores)
```

Question
========
A student scored the following percentages on their end of the year exams:

* Alchemy: 82
* Astrology: 87
* Falconry: 78
* Logic: 89
* Music: 57
* Swordsmanship: 64
* Tarot: 81
* Xylomancy: 98

What was their mean score?


Solution
========
The mean score is calculated as:

$$\frac{\sum x}{N} = \frac{82+87+78+89+57+64+81+98}{8} = \frac{636}{8} = 79.5$$

In R:
```r
x <- c(82, 87, 78, 89, 57, 64, 81, 98)
mean(x)
```

The mean score is **`r fmt(res, 2)`**.
